function.name: set_breakpoint
function.description: Set or delete a debugger breakpoint when variable history is insufficient.

target.description: Include and 1-based source line, for example Z_CALC:51

function.name: step_debugger
function.description: Continue or step the debugger to the next relevant execution point.

function.name: report_findings
function.description: Report the final diagnosis based on runtime evidence.

fix_suggestion.description: Mandatory concrete fix: corrected ABAP code or an exact replacement fragment. A diagnosis-only explanation is invalid. For confirmed findings, include executable ABAP in this field.
